text:
APPROVE

The extractions (`CheckMergedPinsAsync`, `CheckBenchAsync`, `BaseArmAtPinAsync`, `ShortPin`) keep the original conditions, cache behaviour, messages and return values, and they take enough of the nesting out of `CheckAsync` to plausibly bring it under 15. I could only check the diff, not a build, so two things are unconfirmed: whether the unshown tail of `CheckBenchAsync` still has every variable it needs, and whether the lone `<param>` tag on `CheckBenchAsync` raises CS1573 if XML documentation is generated.
